'''Malani Bardok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was part of the Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], where she was an armstech trainer.
